Method of Attack: Phishing attack delivering XLS document with malicious macro that downloads and executes GzipLoader malware which fetches, decrypts, and executes IcedID payload
IcedID used as modular banking trojan for credential theft and loader for second-stage malware such as Cobalt Strike, ransomware, wipers
Exploitation of Zimbra CVE-2018-6882 cross-site scripting vulnerability via content-location header in email attachments to inject forwarding rules for victim's emails
Discoverer: Computer Emergency Response Team of Ukraine (CERT-UA)
Impacted Systems: Zimbra Collaboration Suite versions 8.7 and older
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with malicious XLS attachments
Email attachments with malicious content-location header exploiting Zimbra XSS vulnerability
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious jpg attachments with content-location header linking to JavaScript code
Forwarding rules added to victim's Zimbra email accounts
